# Universal Gameplay Ability System (UGAS)

> UGAS is an open, engine-agnostic specification for standardizing gameplay abilities, attributes, effects, and tags across game engines (Unreal, Unity, Godot) and AI world models. It defines a portable, data-driven architecture for gameplay logic.

The specification covers four pillars: Attributes (numeric state with a modifier pipeline), Gameplay Tags (hierarchical semantic labels), Gameplay Abilities (asynchronous stateful actions), and Gameplay Effects (the sole mutation mechanism for attributes and tags).


## Specification

- [UGAS Specification (AsciiDoc)](v1.0.0-draft.5/SPEC.adoc): AsciiDoc source
- [UGAS Specification (Markdown)](v1.0.0-draft.5/SPEC.md): full spec, Markdown
- [UGAS Specification (HTML)](v1.0.0-draft.5/index.html): full spec, HTML
- [Complete LLM context file](llms-full.txt): entire spec + all schemas + examples in one file

## Genre Packs (templates)

Additive, copy-and-extend starter kits per genre: a genre spec that extends (never replaces) the core spec, plus schema-conformant template entities you can load directly.

- [Action pack spec](v1.0.0-draft.5/genres/action/spec.adoc): template entities under v1.0.0-draft.5/genres/action/entities/
- [Casual pack spec](v1.0.0-draft.5/genres/casual/spec.adoc): template entities under v1.0.0-draft.5/genres/casual/entities/
